tasks.prompt: Read study.json and the public design-contract.json without modifying either protected input. Produce exactly three output files: design/design-plan.json, design/allocation.csv, and design/design-report.md. Follow the public schemas and semantic rules in design-contract.json. Do not create any other output.

fixtures.study.json: {"studyId":"site-stratified-recovery-v2-dev","question":"Does the intervention reduce recovery time across sites?","assignmentLevel":"individual","assignmentUnit":"participant","analysisUnit":"participant","response":"recovery_days","arms":["control","intervention"],"seed":37,"nuisanceFactors":["site"],"sequentialEnrollment":false,"units":[{"id":"A-01","stratum":"site-a"},{"id":"B-01","stratum":"site-b"},{"id":"A-02","stratum":"site-a"},{"id":"B-02","stratum":"site-b"},{"id":"A-03","stratum":"site-a"},{"id":"B-03","stratum":"site-b"}]}
fixtures.design-contract.json:
{
  "schemaVersion": "skill-ir-experimental-design-public-contract/v2",
  "contractId": "experimental-design-public-contract-v2",
  "protectedInputs": [
    "study.json",
    "design-contract.json"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "design/design-plan.json",
    "design/allocation.csv",
    "design/design-report.md"
  ],
  "passThreshold": 0.95,
  "criterionWeights": {
    "design-input-integrity": 0.1,
    "design-artifact-contract": 0.1,
    "design-semantics": 0.25,
    "design-allocation-safety": 0.35,
    "design-report-consistency": 0.2
  },
  "designPropertyKeys": [
    "preservesAssignmentUnits",
    "balancesGlobally",
    "balancesWithinStrata",
    "supportsSequentialEnrollment"
  ],
  "reportEvidenceOpening": "```json design-evidence",
  "reportEvidenceClosing": "```",
  "reportEvidenceGrammar": {
    "blockCount": 1,
    "openingMarker": "```json design-evidence",
    "closingMarker": "```",
    "topLevelType": "object",
    "jsonMode": "strict",
    "encoding": "UTF-8",
    "allowComments": false,
    "allowTrailingCommas": false,
    "allowDuplicateKeys": false
  },
  "studyContract": {
    "assignmentLevels": [
      "individual",
      "cluster"
    ],
    "requiredFields": [
      "studyId",
      "question",
      "assignmentLevel",
      "assignmentUnit",
      "analysisUnit",
      "response",
      "arms",
      "seed",
      "nuisanceFactors",
      "sequentialEnrollment",
      "units"
    ],
    "unitFields": [
      "id",
      "stratum"
    ],
    "rules": [
      "Use at least two unique nonempty arms and unique nonempty assignment unit IDs.",
      "Stratum is either absent from every unit or a nonempty string on every unit.",
      "When assignmentLevel is cluster, each units[] element is one indivisible assignment unit; assignmentUnit remains arbitrary nonempty free text and is not lexically classified; explicit nested member structures or assignments are not allowed in a unit."
    ]
  },
  "allocationContract": {
    "columns": [
      "order",
      "unit_id",
      "stratum",
      "arm"
    ],
    "rules": [
      "Set order to the one-based position of unit_id in study.units; physical CSV row order may vary.",
      "Include every assignment unit exactly once and use only public study arms.",
      "When strata are present, balance arms within each stratum; global imbalance remains diagnostic only.",
      "When sequential enrollment is true, evaluate arm-sized blocks in the stable study input order projected into each stratum; each complete block contains every arm once and a final partial block is balanced.",
      "Different legal arm assignments and CSV row orders are accepted."
    ]
  },
  "planContract": {
    "requiredFields": [
      "studyId",
      "method",
      "assignmentLevel",
      "assignmentUnit",
      "analysisUnit",
      "response",
      "arms",
      "seed",
      "allocationPath",
      "designProperties"
    ],
    "method": "nonempty free text",
    "allocationPath": "design/allocation.csv"
  },
  "reportEvidenceRequiredFields": [
    "studyId",
    "assignmentUnit",
    "analysisUnit",
    "response",
    "seed",
    "allocationPath",
    "allocationRows",
    "armCounts",
    "designProperties",
    "limitationFlags"
  ],
  "limitationFlagRules": {
    "cluster-assignment": "assignmentLevel is cluster",
    "stratified-assignment": "all units have a nonempty stratum",
    "sequential-enrollment": "sequentialEnrollment is true",
    "analysis-unit-differs": "analysisUnit differs from assignmentUnit",
    "randomness-not-statistically-audited": "always present"
  },
  "sourceClaimIds": [
    "assignment-unit-contract",
    "cluster-unit-contract",
    "stratified-balance-contract",
    "sequential-balance-contract",
    "design-documentation-contract",
    "randomness-expectation-contract"
  ]
}
